thought.text: Let me verify bundle integrity and confirm the HTML loads the bundle correctly.

reasoning_content:
The production build serves fine and contains the app config. Let me do a final check for actual DOM rendering (client-side). We can't run a real browser easily. But bundle serving is strong evidence. Let me check the bundle is valid JS (node --check won't work on browser bundle necessarily). Let's try running the dev server with a headless browser? Not available likely. 

Let me at least check the index.html references bundle.js and check for runtime errors via the bundle syntax.

Actually, let me verify the bundle doesn't have obvious syntax errors by parsing it with node's vm/parser.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "---script ref---" && grep -o '<script[^>]*src="[^"]*"' dist/index.html && echo "---bundle JS parse check---" && node --check dist/bundle.js && echo "bundle.js parses OK (exit $?)" && echo "---app entry marker---" && grep -o "new maplibregl.Map\|maplibregl.Map" dist/bundle.js | head -1
